reason: An agent-workflow extension for DeepSeek Harness that adds structured planning and review workflows, persistent memory, checkpoints, branches, staged file diffs, media utilities, migration tools, notifications, and related client interfaces.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体工作流插件，提供规划与审查文档流程、持久记忆、工作区检查点、分支、暂存差异、媒体处理、数据迁移和通知等功能。
summaries.en: An agent-workflow plugin for DeepSeek Harness offering planning and review document workflows, persistent memory, workspace checkpoints, branches, staged diffs, media processing, migration tools, and notifications.

capabilities: Provides agent-oriented design, progress, review, and planning workflows
Stores, recalls, compresses, and injects persistent memory
Creates, lists, previews, restores, deletes, and verifies workspace checkpoints
Creates, switches, edits, and deletes session branches
Stages, previews, accepts, and rejects file diffs
Performs batch line-level code deletion with a stated size guard
Processes local images and optionally invokes model channels for image generation or background removal
Imports legacy Gray Code data and sends desktop or browser notifications
